name: Oran's Gratitude
summary: You bring Oran Snakewrithe a tablet, and Rin'ji's chain reaches its end.

sections.title: A Tablet for Oran
sections.body: After Rin'ji's Secret, you carry the tablet to Oran Snakewrithe. You place it in his hands.

sections.title: Oran's Answer
sections.body: You tell Oran Snakewrithe the tablet came from a small, deserted island at the Overlook Cliffs. He finds the discovery very interesting and carefully puts the tablet away. Then he says the Dark Lady will be very pleased.

faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe receives the tablet at the end of the chain that began with Rin'ji is Trapped! and continued through Rin'ji's Secret.

faq.q: What comes before this in the chain?
faq.answer: Rin'ji's Secret comes before this, preceded by Rin'ji is Trapped!.
